== Acquisition ==
* Dropped by any type of [[boar]], while the player has the collection [[The Bifrost III: The Legend]] unlocked or [[The Dreamer III: The Lover]] completed.
** They can be farmed easily west of the [[Hunting Lodge]] in [[Queensdale]].

== Used in ==
{{recipe list}}

== Notes ==
{{anomaly|
* It can, in ''very'' rare cases, drop from NPCs that are not boars. 
** It additionally drops quite often from [[Transcended creature]]s.
}}
* A total of six are required for the Bifrost collection, and one is needed for the Dreamer collection.
* This item will keep on dropping, even after both collections have been completed.
